name: enquire-mcp-basic
description: One-click, read-only Markdown access to an Obsidian vault: 13 focused tools, two resource surfaces, local execution, and no MCP prompts.
long_description: The deliberately small desktop edition of enquire-mcp. Select one Obsidian vault and give an MCP client cited, freshness-aware access to Markdown notes through exactly 13 read-only tools. It includes the recommended hybrid search surface (gracefully degraded to local pure-JavaScript TF-IDF), exact live text search, wikilink navigation, tags, stats, and frontmatter queries. The Basic bundle does not expose writes, feedback, persistent index builders, model acquisition, PDF/OCR, Canvas, Bases, Dataview, watcher controls, or MCP prompts. enquire itself initiates no outbound calls while serving; the connected MCP client remains a separate trust boundary and may process returned note content under its own terms.

tools.name: obsidian_list_notes
